summary: Customer produces an opaque, concentrated milk product flowing through a processing line. They currently sample for fat and protein analysis and want earlier information about composition changes. Product temperature and texture vary during production. They request an initial spectroscopy concept and a practical comparison experiment while retaining laboratory checks.
